name: Dramatic Deep Dive
description: Full-Kanto Deep Dive preview with continuous water under bridges, docks and pontoons. With Wilds of Kanto active, underwater random/vanilla encounters are hard-disabled and only visible overworld Pokemon interception can start wild battles. Includes seamless underwater connections, cave/harbor portals, biome-aware geology and lighting, Pokedex-scaled wildlife, salvage and HM08 DIVE.
